classifications.remediation: Enable virtualization in your BIOS/UEFI (often called "Intel VT-x", "AMD-V", or "SVM"), then enable the Windows feature: open PowerShell as Administrator, run `Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName VirtualMachinePlatform`, and reboot.
Update WSL: open PowerShell and run `wsl --update`, then retry.
Open PowerShell as Administrator, run `wsl --install`, reboot, then re-run `appliance init`.
Set `networkingMode=NAT` under `[wsl2]` in `%USERPROFILE%\.wslconfig` (or remove the setting), run `wsl --shutdown`, then retry.
